name: dell-ai-factory-agentic-workspace
description: Connect to and manage Dell AI Factory Agentic Workspace (built on Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces) using the Devspaces CLI connector.

interface.shortDescription: Connect and manage Dell AI Factory Agentic Workspace.
interface.longDescription: Local Codex integration for Dell AI Factory Agentic Workspace, built on Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces: authentication guidance, status, start, stop, restart, and managed SSH tunnels through a Dev Spaces CLI connector. Requires local Python, a connector installation, and network access to your own Dev Spaces cluster. Optional Kubernetes diagnostics remain available.
defaultPrompt: Authenticate to Dell AI Factory Agentic Workspace and list my workspaces.
Check the status of my Dev Spaces workspace.
Restart my Dev Spaces workspace and verify its status.
